definitions: A set of image processing techniques that process images based on shapes, often used for pre-processing, post-processing, and feature extraction.
Mathematical operations applied to binary or grayscale images that alter the structure of objects within the image based on a structuring element.
examples: Erosion and dilation are fundamental morphological operations.
The engineer applied a series of morphological operations to clean up the noisy image.
Understanding morphological operations is key in many computer vision tasks.
